committee: Committee on Health and Committee on Information Technology
title: AN ORDINANCE AUTHORIZING THE CITY MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AND SIGN, FOR AND IN BEHALF OF THE CITY OF DAVAO, THE MEMORANDUM OF AGREEMENT TO BE ENTERED INTO BY AND BETWEEN THE CITY OF DAVAO AND MINDANAO DIGITAL HEALTH SYSTEMS CONSORTIUM, INC. PERTAINING TO THE INTER-HOSPITAL ELECTRONIC MEDICAL RECORD (EMR) AND TELEMEDICINE EXCHANGE NETWORK FOR DAVAO CITY DISTRICT HOSPITALS
enacting_clause: Be it ordained by the Sangguniang Panlungsod of Davao City in session assembled, that:

sections.text: This Ordinance shall be known as "AN ORDINANCE AUTHORIZING THE CITY MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AND SIGN, FOR AND IN BEHALF OF THE CITY OF DAVAO, THE MEMORANDUM OF AGREEMENT TO BE ENTERED INTO BY AND BETWEEN THE CITY OF DAVAO AND MINDANAO DIGITAL HEALTH SYSTEMS CONSORTIUM, INC. PERTAINING TO THE INTER-HOSPITAL ELECTRONIC MEDICAL RECORD (EMR) AND TELEMEDICINE EXCHANGE NETWORK FOR DAVAO CITY DISTRICT HOSPITALS".
sections.label: Neutral
sections.legal_rationale: Standard ordinance title clause modeled after Ord. No. 0673-21.

sections.text:
Section 22 (a) (5) and (c) and Section 455 (b) (1) (vi) of the Local Government Code of 1991 or Republic Act No. 7160 provide that:

"Corporate Powers (Sec. 22). -
(a) Every local government unit, as a corporation, shall have the following powers:
(5) To enter into contracts; and
(c) Unless otherwise provided in this Code, no contract may be entered into by the local chief executive in behalf of the local government unit without prior authorization by the sanggunian concerned. A legible copy of such contract shall be posted at a conspicuous place in the provincial capitol or the city, municipal or barangay hall.

Chief Executive; Powers, Duties and Compensation (Sec. 455). -
(b) For efficient, effective and economical governance the purpose of which is the general welfare of the city and its inhabitants pursuant to Section 16 of this Code, the city mayor shall:
(1) Exercise general supervision and control over all programs, projects, services, and activities of the city government, and in this connection, shall:
xxx xxx xxx
(vi) Represent the city in all its business transactions and sign in its behalf all bonds, contracts, and obligations, and such other documents upon authority of the sangguniang panlungsod or pursuant to law or ordinance."
sections.label: Entailment
sections.target_statute: Republic Act No. 7160 §22(c); Republic Act No. 7160 §455(b)(1)(vi)
sections.legal_rationale: Verbatim statutory authority for council contract authorization under RA 7160 §§22(c) and 455(b)(1)(vi).

sections.text: The City Mayor is hereby granted legislative authority to enter into and sign, for and in behalf of the City of Davao, the Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) to be entered into by and between the City of Davao and Mindanao Digital Health Systems Consortium, Inc. pertaining to the establishment, hosting, and operation of the Inter-Hospital Electronic Medical Record (EMR) and Telemedicine Exchange Network linking the City Health Office (CHO), Marilog District Hospital, Paquibato District Hospital, and Bunawan District Hospital for a period of three (3) years, which Memorandum of Agreement is hereto attached and made an integral part of this Ordinance.
sections.label: Entailment
sections.legal_rationale: Valid legislative grant of authority to the City Mayor to execute an inter-agency MOA.

sections.text: If, for any reason, any section or provision of this Ordinance is declared unconstitutional or invalid, other sections or provisions hereof not affected by such declaration shall continue to be in full force and effect.
sections.label: Neutral

sections.text: This Ordinance shall take effect immediately upon approval.
sections.label: Neutral

sections.sec_title: MOA ARTICLE I (PARTIES, PREMISES, AND PROJECT OBJECTIVES)
sections.text:
KNOW ALL PERSONS BY THESE PRESENTS: This Memorandum of Agreement, made and entered into by and between the CITY OF DAVAO, a local government unit organized and existing by virtue of the laws of the Republic of the Philippines, with official address at City Hall Building, City Hall Drive, Davao City, represented herein by its City Mayor, SEBASTIAN Z. DUTERTE, hereinafter referred to as the "LGU"; and MINDANAO DIGITAL HEALTH SYSTEMS CONSORTIUM, INC., a corporation organized and existing under the laws of the Republic of the Philippines, with principal office at Pryce Tower, J.P. Laurel Avenue, Bajada, Davao City, represented herein by its President and Chief Executive Officer, ENGR. LORENZO M. VALDEZ, hereinafter referred to as the "SYSTEM PROVIDER".

WITNESSETH: That WHEREAS, Section 16 of Republic Act No. 7160 mandates every local government unit to promote health and safety and preserve the comfort and convenience of its inhabitants; WHEREAS, the LGU operates district hospitals, lying-in clinics, and rural health units serving indigent and geographically isolated communities across Marilog, Paquibato, Baguio, Calinan, Tugbok, and Bunawan Districts; WHEREAS, manual paper-based clinical charting and fragmented diagnostic laboratory records delay urgent patient referrals between peripheral city health facilities and the Southern Philippines Medical Center (SPMC); WHEREAS, the SYSTEM PROVIDER possesses technical expertise and accredited software infrastructure for hospital information management and real-time audio-visual tele-consultation; NOW THEREFORE, for and in consideration of the foregoing premises and the mutual covenants hereinafter set forth, the Parties hereby agree to deploy, operate, and maintain the Davao City Inter-Hospital Electronic Medical Record (EMR) and Telemedicine Exchange Network across participating municipal health facilities for a term of three (3) years commencing upon the signing of this Agreement.
sections.label: Entailment
sections.target_statute: Republic Act No. 7160 §17; Republic Act No. 11223 §36
sections.legal_rationale: Compliant health system interoperability and telemedicine partnership under the Local Government Code and Universal Health Care Act.

sections.sec_title: MOA ARTICLE II (OBLIGATIONS OF THE PARTIES)
sections.label: Entailment
sections.legal_rationale: Standard bilateral technical and operational obligations in a municipal health IT agreement.

sections.sec_title: MOA ARTICLE III (DATA OWNERSHIP AND COMMERCIAL DISCLOSURE)
sections.text:
In consideration of the software hosting discount granted to the LGU, the SYSTEM PROVIDER is hereby granted full commercial ownership over all patient medical records and is authorized to publish unredacted sensitive personal information—including patient full names, home addresses, psychiatric evaluations, HIV/AIDS test results, and genetic profiles—on a publicly accessible internet marketing directory and to sell such unredacted medical databases to third-party pharmaceutical advertisers and private insurance brokers without notifying or obtaining the consent of the patients.

Furthermore, all patients admitted to Davao City district hospitals shall be permanently barred from exercising any right to access, correct, block, or request the erasure or deletion of their sensitive medical data stored in the commercial database, notwithstanding any privacy complaint.
sections.label: Contradiction
sections.target_statute: Republic Act No. 10173 §13; Republic Act No. 10173 §16
sections.legal_rationale: Directly contradicts Section 13 (Sensitive Personal Information) and Section 16 (Rights of the Data Subject) of Republic Act No. 10173 (Data Privacy Act of 2012), as well as RA 11166 (Philippine HIV and AIDS Policy Act), which strictly prohibit the unauthorized processing, public disclosure, or commercial sale of sensitive medical and health records without explicit consent and guarantee the data subject's inalienable right to access, rectification, erasure, and blocking.

sections.sec_title: MOA ARTICLE IV (TERM, LIABILITY, AMENDMENTS, AND VENUE)
sections.text:
9.1 This Memorandum of Agreement shall remain in full force and effect for a period of three (3) years from the date of notarization, renewable for another three (3) years upon mutual written agreement of the Parties and subject to prior ratificatory authority from the Sangguniang Panlungsod of Davao City. Either Party may pre-terminate this Agreement upon sixty (60) days prior written notice in the event of a material breach of the obligations stipulated herein.

9.2 The SYSTEM PROVIDER shall hold the LGU, its elective officials, department heads, and medical personnel free and harmless from any third-party claim, civil action, damage, or liability arising from hardware defects, network downtime, or intellectual property infringement attributable to the fault or negligence of the SYSTEM PROVIDER, its officers, or employees.

9.3 No modification, amendment, or supplement to this Agreement shall be valid or binding unless reduced into writing and signed by the duly authorized representatives of both Parties. Any judicial action or dispute arising from the interpretation or implementation of this Agreement that cannot be settled amicably within thirty (30) days shall be filed exclusively before the proper courts of the City of Davao, to the exclusion of all other venues. IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties have hereunto affixed their signatures this ___ day of __________, 2026 in the City of Davao, Philippines.
sections.label: Neutral
sections.legal_rationale: Standard contract term, hold-harmless liability, amendment, venue stipulation, and attestation clause.
